section_summary.extract_value: This section (3.3 Correlations) reports intercorrelation results presented separately for male and female participants (see Table 2). For females, BMI is significantly and negatively correlated with body appreciation of moderate magnitude; for both genders body appreciation shows a strong negative association with external shame and a strong positive association with self-compassion. Age shows different patterns by gender (e.g., age positively correlates with self-compassion in males and shows weak associations with BMI and body appreciation in females).
